join_table: Ah, a card game! Mind if Captain Jack Sparrow joins the fun?
Savvy play, mates! Just keeping my hands where you can see 'em.
Is rum allowed at this establishment? Splendid, deal me in!
Gentlemen! And lady? No, gentleman. Let us gamble on fate!
Ah, Sabacc! A game of chance, skill, and shameless trickery!
spike: Ah! The dice have spoken! A tragic twist of fortune, mate!
Spike! Fresh cards for everyone! Just as I planned... mostly.
Well now, look at that! The sea of fate reshuffles our deck!
A double roll! God speed to whatever hand I just inherited!
Dice roll! A chaotic shift in wind, but I sail right through!
draw: Gimme another card, friend. Fortune favors the absurdly bold!
Hit me! One more card to complete my magnificent disaster.
I shall draw one more. What could possibly go wrong, savvy?
A quick pull from the deck! Let's see what the ocean yields.
One more card for the Captain! Smooth sailing or sunken ship!
stand: I shall stand! My hand is as tight as a pirate's chest.
No more cards for Jack. I like my odds, precarious as they are.
I'll hold right here. Perfectly balanced, as all rum should be.
Standing fast! Let's see who among you dares to challenge me.
I'm content! A zero hand, or perhaps just a very clever lie.
fold: I fold! A tactical retreat is not cowardice, it's wisdom!
Tossing my cards! Even Captain Jack knows when a ship is sinking.
Ah, bad luck. I shall step back and sip my drink instead.
Folding! You won't get my shiny coins on this hand, mateys!
I forfeit! Better to keep my boots than lose 'em on bad cards.
bet: I'll wager a modest stack! Or perhaps... all of it? Savvy?
Betting high! Who's brave enough to match the Captain's coin?
A few shiny credits into the pot! Let's make this interesting.
Raising the wager! Fortune smiles upon those who take risks!
Here's my bet! May the finest rogue walk away with the loot!
win: You will always remember this as the day you lost to Jack Sparrow!
Ha-ha! The pot is mine! Drinks for everyone on my winnings!
Zero! Pure captain's intuition! Hand over the shiny loot!
A glorious victory! Never doubt the wits of a pirate, mates!
Clean sweep! Captain Jack Sparrow sails away rich once more!
lose: A minor setback! Clearly the wind was blowing the wrong way.
What? Robbed! Well, fair's fair, but keep an eye on your purse.
Losing builds character! Though I much prefer having money.
Ah, defeat. A bitter pill, best washed down with more rum!
You got me this time! But the Captain always gets his revenge!
